Given that y1(x)=e−4x is a solution to the equation y″+8y′+16y=0, use reduction of order to find a second solution y2(x) to the equation, and write down the general solution.

a
y=Ae−4x+Bxe−4x
b
y=Ae−4x+Bxe−2x
c
y=Ae−4x+Be4x
d
y=Ae−4x+Be8x
e
y=Ae−4x+Bxe2x
